description.html: This dish has a kidney shape with rounded edges, like the light blue version, but in matte dark grey with a slightly grainy outer surface. The dark color is unobtrusive and does not draw attention away from your animal and the decor, so it blends well into a natural-looking terrarium with darker substrate, bark and rocks.

It is suitable for water or food for lizards, snakes and turtles. The smooth inside is easy to wash and does not hold deposits the way porous stone dishes do, which is practical when you keep several terrariums and want quick maintenance.
The kidney shape lets you place the inner curve against a hide, rock or branch so the dish fits into the layout more neatly.

Dirt is harder to see on a dark surface than on a light one, so do not wait for the water to look dirty: change it every day. To keep it from shifting, place the dish on a level surface and press it slightly into the substrate. Do not place it directly under a heat source.
